premises.text: People often lose track of their good ideas across multiple file storage solutions.
premises.evidence_span: Have you ever had a really good idea and then lost it? A really great idea? Where is it? Where did I put it? Is it in my desktop? Is it in my Dropbox? Is it in my inbox? Where is my great idea? I have no idea.

premises.text: A single platform can consolidate and index files from various repositories.
premises.evidence_span: We just need one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips.

premises.text: Files can be stripped of formatting to allow for individual components to be used.
premises.evidence_span: We take every file that we find and we strip away the file formatting. So all that's left are individual components.

premises.text: Search functionality can return relevant content based on indexed components.
premises.evidence_span: So all you have to do is type in one search term, one click of a button, and your best content, your best page, not a file, your best page, appears to you in the order of relevance.

premises.text: The platform learns user preferences over time to improve search results.
premises.evidence_span: Docurated learns over time. The more you use a piece of content after searching for it, the easier it will be for you to get to it.

premises.text: Natural language processing can analyze content without user tagging.
premises.evidence_span: Natural language processing. You don't ever have to tag anything. We will analyze your words.

premises.text: Users can create and export visual collages from various content components.
premises.evidence_span: Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format.

premises.text: Docurated is beneficial for both large enterprises and individual users.
premises.evidence_span: But we don't believe that Docurated only belongs to large enterprises. We believe that Docurated belongs to everyone.

value.text: Docurated provides a unified solution for managing and retrieving ideas effectively.
value.evidence_span: Docurated provides my team and I with the exact information we require and the ability to share best practices globally.

notes: Exclusions include specific customer testimonials and financial figures as they do not represent premises.
